test_unknown_field_serialization: test that unknown fields are preserved when serializing a protobuf message with unrecognized fields
test_discard_unknown_fields: test that calling DiscardUnknownFields removes all unknown fields from a protobuf message
test_unknown_field_merge: test that merging two protobuf messages correctly combines their unknown fields
test_unknown_enum_values: test that unknown enum values are preserved as unknown fields in protobuf messages
test_unknown_field_memory_leak: test that accessing unknown fields does not cause memory leaks using tracemalloc
